environment.description: Kubernetes pod running the notification service with default container runtime settings. Pod has network access to internal SMTP relay on port 25. Container runs with default seccomp profile (runtime/default) which permits all standard syscalls including socket creation. No input validation middleware or WAF in front of the service. SMTP relay accepts and forwards all well-formed messages without header inspection.

config.smtp_relay: postfix relay with no content filtering
config.ingress: direct ClusterIP service, no API gateway
